name: Wheelhouse plugins
description: The official Wheelhouse plugins registry: first-party plugins that live in repositories of their own.

plugins.name: docket
plugins.description: A project's docket casebook in Wheelhouse: browse and search its libraries, services and decisions, ask questions, and see docket search results drawn in the chat.
plugins.author: Chris Owen

plugins.name: improve
plugins.description: An Improvements page with improve's proposals for Firstmate's harness, its review schedule and evidence, each proposal waiting for your call.
plugins.author: Chris Owen

plugins.name: captains-log
plugins.description: A short digest on the home page: what landed since you were last here, what waits on you, and what is under way and next.
plugins.author: Chris Owen

plugins.name: giffy-wheelhouse
plugins.description: A catalogue of pre-checked GIFs, by occasion, for Firstmate's chat, with a GIFs page to browse them.
plugins.author: Chris Owen

plugins.name: git-insights
plugins.description: A Git insights page with figures across every project and each project's own: contributors, latest commits, code hotspots and open pull requests.
plugins.author: Chris Owen

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: A project tab that reviews a pull request as a guided chat, one change at a time, then drafts a review to post, using a local model.
plugins.author: Chris Owen

plugins.name: ship-weather
plugins.description: Fleet health as weather in the header, from clear to stormy; click it for what's wrong, why, and the latest events.
plugins.author: Chris Owen

plugins.name: localhost-proxy
plugins.description: Opens the crew's localhost previews and links through Wheelhouse itself, so they work when Wheelhouse runs in Docker, a cloud workspace or another computer.
plugins.author: Chris Owen
